items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I knew more about the family in a way than Sylvester and Cal. They were just other school and go.

ctx.x: Were they from your mother's side?

No, no, they were from my daddy's side. Distant cousins from my daddy's side. And, well, we were, from what I know, I knew more about the family in a way than Sylvester and Cal. They were just other school and go. Well, I hate to say it, well, I can't help it. But I'm a polio victim. I never did work. My daddy didn't want me to work. He didn't want me to get married. And he, they just, anyway, everywhere my daddy had gone, I had to be right there. And, uh.

items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: sometimes Calc and Sylvester would come home with a whole cycle.

ctx.x: Just walk along and, uh, we'd take sticks and catch them. And, uh, sometimes Calc and Sylvester would come home with a whole cycle.
Toes work just as well, too. Uh-huh. Toes work just as well.
